pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, jagged, and star-like (stellate) geometries with soft, diffuse pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp transitions. Patches are relatively small in spatial area compared to the surrounding light pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of broad, continuous light-colored pathways with thick junction nodes. The thickness of these pathways is high relative to patch diameter, creating an expansive, interconnected topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane along the cervical-dorsal ridge showing a fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette with low vertical amplitude.
